page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a note block in the left margin at the top and another in the left margin lower down. Running head and page number at the top; catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: descendere eam, compulisset. Conditiones hæ fuere. Exules ad sua, ut tum erant, redi-rent, nec actiones de damno haberent: Canon quinquennio non solutus collegio ob bellum, starim solveretur: civitas episcopo ius praefecturæ suburbanæ cederet: is praefectum pro arbitrio daret, qui sedem & tribunal habe-ret in urbe, id est, ut verbo dicam, pactio prior cum collegio esset irrita. Id pridie Michae-lis anni M. cccc. v. confectum. Triduo post, de urbano jure sic porro transactum. Civitas Groninga e numero civium suorum Scul-THESIVM, id est, praefectum ederet, quem vellet, munus ei abrogaret, successōrem daret, continuaret, quando, quoties, quandiu placeret: editus vero, successore datus apud praefectum suburbanum episcopi ministrum ju-raret[?]Dat hemal lirk oĳ del bĳ recht doen bnb/tweder baren laten fal/na olden hebrkamen des gerich tes in [?]mingen. juramenti summa hæc esset, jus & justitiam se administraturum omnib. integre atque incorrupte secundum morem fori istius: praefecto suburbano ultra triduum tergiversante, consuli potestas esset hoc juramentum ab eo recipere eadem verborum forma. Pro hoc jure civitas quotannis aureos scutatos Franci-cos xxviii penderet episcopo ipsi Ultrajecti, & vigesimo quoq; anno marcas duas argenti puri cum marcæ triente praefecto Coverdiæ, utrumq; ante exitum Octobris: Et hæc pactio vim haberet in annos c. quibus finitis, si civitas ante exitum ejusdem Octobris offerret episcopo marcas argenti similis xvi, & trientem marcarum duarum, peteretq; ejusdem juris & pacti continuationem, eadem omnia valerent in annos totidem; & ab eorum fine rursum repetitis ijsdem, &

page.notes: Left margin, top: the note "Transfactio duplex cum Friderico Blanchenhe-mio." is printed beside the first lines of the page. It is a marginal note and is placed here at the start of the paragraph, so it does not appear in the main text. Left margin, lower: a black-letter Dutch note in several short lines; its wording is uncertain and marked [?]. The text has a printer's ornament before "Michaelis" that is not a letter and was left out. "descendere" and "suorum" have long s printed as f, rendered as plain s. The word "juraret" is broken across lines as "ju-" and "raret"; the second part is doubtful. Numbers and abbreviations are copied as printed. Bottom right: "pactis" is a catchword and is placed in bottom_margin, not in the text. Scan quality is good, with slight show-through at the page edges, which is not transcribed.
